name: Bard Alasdair

intro.text: I make songs about the sea, the weather, and a woman in Back who will not return my phone calls. Each has more verses than you'd expect. Fancy a battle in four-four time?

win: A good fight. I'll put you in a verse.
after: Gaelic song has a verse for every occasion: waulking songs, rowing songs, lullabies, songs for the weather and songs for a man who's late for his tea.
